name: Post-Earnings Long Call (trend continuation)
summary: Buy a call AFTER the report, once IV has collapsed, to ride post-earnings announcement drift with cheap premium.

greeks.vega: positive - and here it is a tailwind, because you are buying after the crush, at the IV floor

when_to_use: 1-3 days after a positive earnings surprise, when IVR has dropped below 25 from its pre-report peak and the stock closed the report day in the top quartile of its range.
entry_rules: Entry window: 1 to 3 trading days after the earnings release
IVR must have fallen below 25 post-report
Stock gapped up and closed the report day in the upper 25% of the day's range
Price above the pre-earnings high on a closing basis
No other earnings event before the exit date
management_rules: Time stop at 21 DTE or 15 trading days held
exit_rules: Sell to close at +80%, -45%, 21 DTE, or 15 trading days
15:30 ET expiry-day flatten if ever carried that far
common_mistakes: Entering before the IV has finished collapsing; chasing a gap that has already filled.
